data.long_meaning: One who is victorious and overcomes all obstacles. The name Jitvan carries the meaning “Victorious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Jitvan usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner strength and determination to overcome challenges and obstacles in life
data.etymology: Jitvan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jitvan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The Hindu name "Jitvan" signifies strength, courage, and victory in Hindu culture. Ancient Hindu texts often depict gods and heroes who are brave warriors or victorious rulers, inspiring the use of a warlike name like Jitvan. In Hindu society, having a powerful name is considered auspicious and desirable.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, Jitvan represents the divine spark of victory that resides within every individual. It serves as a reminder that no matter the obstacles, each person has the inner strength and courage to overcome them. This name can inspire one to strive for spiritual growth and renewed determination on the spiritual path.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Jitvan: Victorious in the battlefield of life; embodiment of indomitable spirit.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Jitvan was a king of the Vatsa kingdom in the 5th century BCE. The name Jitvan carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Jitvan remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Radha Jitvan in Mumbai, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Jitvan, which means "Victorious". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
